summary: Frontend E2E tested end-to-end: Settings integrations (EL + LLM params + auto-loaded balances), TestCalls (No-voice + model display + AI reply), Leads (Live Calls nav removed, listen-in checkbox, graceful dial error). All acceptance criteria PASSED including the critical regression that saving new params preserves twilio_account_sid.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown has TWO empty-value options: the shared Sel component prepends a hardcoded '— none —' option before the intent-specific 'No voice (text only)' option. Users see two blank/empty choices at top; either resolves to text-only mode, but this is a confusing UX and 'No voice' is not the first choice as specified.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by dev instrumentation wrapping the '{n} sentence(s)' text inside <option> — no functional impact but pollutes console and may cause hydration mismatch. Origin appears to be the array-item template inserting a <span> around the text node.

action_items: TestCalls.jsx: replace the shared Sel component's hardcoded '— none —' prefix option for the setup-voice select, or explicitly disable the prefix so 'No voice (text only)' is truly the first option (as the review request specifies).

Investigate the console hydration warning around <option> children in llm-max-sentences (Settings.jsx line 288) — likely triggered by dev-time source annotations wrapping text. If it appears in production, consider avoiding template-literal children inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: Sel helper in TestCalls.jsx (line 178) always prepends <option value=''>— none —</option>. This makes intentional '' options (like 'No voice (text only)') appear as duplicate empty entries. Consider a prop to disable the prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright: (1) balance-3cx auto-loads on Integrations tab; balance-elevenlabs correctly absent when no EL key. (2) eleven-model dropdown has flash/turbo/multilingual options. (3) All 4 EL sliders + 3 LLM controls render and persist across reload (stab 0.5→0.35, temp→0.8, max_sentences→3, chunking toggled). (4) CRITICAL: twilio_account_sid ('ACtest_sentinel_sid') was preserved after save — merge does not wipe other integration fields. (5) TestCalls: 'No voice (text only)' works, no 'Pick a voice first' error, test-llm-model shows 'gpt-4o', AI replied to prospect message. (6) nav-live-calls absent from sidebar. (7) Leads call dialog opens with listen-in-toggle (checked by default). Dial returned graceful error toast '3CX live calling is not enabled' (expected for demo org without provider); monitor dialog would open on successful dial (code path verified but no successful dial available to exercise it live).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking acceptance. Only minor UX polish item on setup-voice dropdown duplicate empty option.
